scientific_scope: independent external confirmation of one already-frozen exact 7+ conditional tail law q(k|T>=7); no parameter fitting, no feature search, no D|T, no unified score matrix
current_rule_basis: CURRENT V5.2 permits 7+ total mass plus an independently validated normalized conditional tail law with explicit algorithm, time-order OOS evidence, cross-season/competition stability, and unenumerated residual <=1e-8

score_access_contract.allowed_label: score.ft only, exactly two nonnegative integer goals
score_access_contract.selection: only identities matching the pre-frozen source_file|date|team1|team2 key and horizon
score_access_contract.missing_or_invalid: exclude with zero replacement; never substitute another identity
score_access_contract.penalty_or_extra_time_fields: not used; fixed files are domestic league-season files

estimand.fixed_prediction: same frozen q for every external tail match; no external refit or recalibration

statistics.oracle_external_r: diagnostic only; MLE r_hat=sum(E)/sum(E+1), never used to alter frozen predictions

all_required: coverage gate passes before effect interpretation
frozen r lies inside pooled match-bootstrap 90% CI for external r_hat
frozen predicted mean excess lies inside pooled match-bootstrap 90% CI for external mean E
discrete KS Monte Carlo p-value against frozen geometric law >=0.05
frozen P(E>=1)=r lies inside external Wilson 90% interval
frozen P(E>=2)=r^2 lies inside external Wilson 90% interval
at least 2 calendar-year blocks are eligible (tail n>=10) and at least half of eligible year blocks have frozen r inside their match-bootstrap 90% CI
at least 3 league-family blocks are eligible (tail n>=8) and at least half of eligible family blocks have frozen r inside their match-bootstrap 90% CI
frozen_confirmation_gate.decision: STOP_COVERAGE if coverage fails; CONFIRMATION_PASS only if every required gate passes; otherwise CONFIRMATION_FAIL_PARK
frozen_confirmation_gate.failure_rule: external labels are consumed once; no changes to r, family, thresholds, files, cutoff, cluster minima, bootstrap seeds, confidence levels or goodness-of-fit test are allowed after result view
